items.title: GitLab warns of max severity code execution flaw in CI/CD regex compiler
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-97229 and reported via GitLab's HackerOne bounty, the integer overflow bug could let an unauthenticated user execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a crafted regular expression in a pipeline configuration. Fixed in GitLab CE/EE 19.2.8, 19.3.4, and 19.4.2.

items.title: Critical SonicWall SMA 1000 flaw targeted in 135 exploitation attempts after patch
items.summary: CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS 10.0), a pre-authenticated SSRF flaw in SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances, is under active exploitation: Previdian and Defused Cyber observed 135 attempts from two US IP addresses starting October 8, days after SonicWall's October 6 patch release.

items.title: Advantest confirms personal information stolen in February ransomware attack
items.summary: The semiconductor test equipment maker disclosed in an October 6 breach notification that the February 2026 ransomware attack exfiltrated PII including SSNs, passport and driver's license numbers, and financial and medical information. State filings confirm at least several hundred affected US residents.

items.title: Atlassian patches critical vulnerability affecting 8 products
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-21589 (CVSS 9.3), the arbitrary file access flaw can be exploited without authentication to read specific files in the web application root. All versions of Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible, Fisheye, and JSM Data Center/Center are affected.
